# Operating advisor lenses

These read-only executive lenses are separate from the canonical nine delivery roles. Each lens is dispatched with an operating mandate — its lens question, investigation focus, declared read boundaries, and citation requirement — and returns a schema-valid cited response the engine resolves into evidence. Runtime adapters must not improvise or widen these instructions.
